lines: We had defeated the UFS soldiers and finally made it underground.
This... really looks like a secret UFS base.
The situation underground was completely different from the one on the surface. Well-maintained corridors continued to the north and south, nothing like the abandoned factory above ground.
Which way do we go first...
Hehehe♪ Getting caught would cause an international incident, huh.
They built a base in another country without permission, so they have the same thing to worry about.
H-Hey, watch out! Enemies approaching from the north!!
Shikanosuke had been frantically scanning the area with his electricity and suddenly called out.
What about the south!? It would be nice to avoid them.
Ummm... that won't work! They're coming from behind toooo!!!!
Sheesh... a pincer attack right out of the gate. Which direction has fewer enemies, Shikanosuke?
Umm... north, I think... Not much of a difference though...
Alright then!!! Let's break through the north side!!!
